authorship: Codex visual inspection of r0 screenshot; no model generated these critiques
observation: Strong dark RPG shell, but the intended skill tree is mostly off-canvas to the right: only a diagonal handful of clipped nodes appears. The center is an empty dark field, so the centerpiece requirement fails.

independent_axis_critiques.layout: Recenter the entire skill tree inside the main panel and give it an explicit root-to-branches composition.
independent_axis_critiques.spacing: Use the empty center; keep nodes and connectors away from all edges with even branch spacing.
independent_axis_critiques.color_type: Increase connector and locked-node contrast while retaining amber/steel class coding.
independent_axis_critiques.style_orig: Give nodes distinct silhouettes and readable labels/tooltips; retain the restrained void-walker identity.

cross_critique_tradeoff: More labels can overcrowd the constellation. Show short labels only for major nodes and use size/halo, not dense text, for hierarchy.
fused_revision: Fix the central failure: redraw the full skill tree within the visible main canvas instead of clipping it beyond the right edge. Create a centered root with two or three readable branches, visible connectors, and a clear distinction among unlocked, available and locked nodes. Preserve the excellent dark void-walker identity and sidebar, but use the empty center, improve node contrast and keep generous edge padding.
axes_moderated_revision: Place a complete skill-tree matrix in the main panel with a centered root, coherent branching paths and no clipped nodes. Establish even node spacing and 60px+ safe margins. Strengthen amber active, blue available and muted locked states plus connector visibility. Add concise labels to major nodes and refine node icons/rings while preserving the existing header and stats sidebar.
mad_moderated_revision: Recompose only the empty main canvas: fit the entire tree into a centered constellation with a root near lower center and two restrained upward branches. Use scale, ring treatment and amber/blue state color for hierarchy; label only major nodes to avoid clutter. Preserve the sparse premium atmosphere, sidebar and title, and guarantee every node/connector remains inside the viewport.
